name: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3
authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: Security requirements for protecting the confidentiality of controlled unclassified information in nonfederal systems and organizations.

requirements.title: Access Control
requirements.description: Limit system access, control information flow, and enforce least privilege for CUI environments.

requirements.title: Awareness and Training
requirements.description: Ensure personnel receive role-appropriate security awareness and training.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Awareness and Training

requirements.title: Audit and Accountability
requirements.description: Create, protect, review, and retain audit records for the CUI environment.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Audit and Accountability

requirements.title: Configuration Management
requirements.description: Establish and monitor secure configurations, inventories, and change control.

requirements.title: Identification and Authentication
requirements.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate users, devices, and processes.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Identification and Authentication

requirements.title: Incident Response
requirements.description: Prepare for, detect, report, analyze, contain, and recover from incidents.

requirements.title: Media Protection
requirements.description: Protect, control, sanitize, and transport system media containing CUI.

requirements.title: Physical Protection
requirements.description: Limit physical access and monitor facilities and devices supporting CUI.

requirements.title: System and Communications Protection
requirements.description: Protect communications, boundaries, and CUI flows in transit and at rest.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, System and Communications Protection

requirements.title: System and Information Integrity
requirements.description: Identify, report, correct, and monitor flaws, malicious code, and anomalous activity.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, System and Information Integrity

requirements.title: Planning
requirements.description: Document security plans, rules of behavior, scope, and responsibilities.

requirements.title: Risk Assessment
requirements.description: Assess risks to organizational operations, assets, individuals, and CUI.

requirements.title: Security Assessment and Monitoring
requirements.description: Assess controls and monitor ongoing effectiveness and changes in the CUI environment.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Security Assessment and Monitoring

requirements.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
requirements.description: Identify and manage supply chain risks affecting CUI systems, services, and components.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Supply Chain Risk Management
